The Mocs, led by first-year head coach [[Lamont Paris]], played their home games at [[McKenzie Arena]] and as members of the [[Southern Conference]]. They finished the season 10–23, 3–15 in SoCon play to finish in last place. They defeated [[2017–18 Samford Bulldogs men's basketball team|Samford]] in the first round of the [[2018 Southern Conference men's basketball tournament|SoCon tournament]] to advance to the quarterfinals where they lost to [[2017–18 East Tennessee State Buccaneers men's basketball team|East Tennessee State]]. ==Previous season== The [[2016–17 Chattanooga Mocs men's basketball team|Mocs]] finished the [[2016–17 NCAA Division I men's basketball season|2016–17 season]] 19–12, 10–8 in SoCon play to finish for fourth place. In the [[2017 Southern Conference men's basketball tournament|SoCon tournament]], they lost to [[2016-17 Wofford Terriers men's basketball team|Wofford]] in the quarterfinals. On March 29, 2017, head coach [[Matt McCall (basketball)|Matt McCall]] left the program to take the head coaching job at [[UMass Minutemen basketball|UMass]].{{cite
